title: ZonePatchRequest
description: Whitelisted-field patch. This is deliberately NOT Partial<Zone>: immutable identity (zone_id, origin trust domain, created_by) never appears, and unknown keys are rejected rather than ignored — a patch naming anything outside the whitelist is a client bug, not a forward-compatibility case.

deployment.description: Partial placement update; whitelisted keys only — trust_domain is immutable and absent on purpose.
